items.title: Jack Lesberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: This chap that played with us now was in a quartet that I did. ... Bob Bernard, yeah.

ctx.x: Bob Bernard, yeah. I got a job at the American National Club. It didn’t pay hardly anything but I had that with the symphony. And also I didn’t accept the position on a steady basis, I left it open in case I wanted to get away or go back. It was part of my © Fillius Jazz Archive -11-

nervousness from freelancing, I figured I might lose something. And in fact I loved Sydney and I’m sorry I left it now. I would have loved to stay there. I made many friends there and it’s a nice country, it really is. But I did come back, due to marital stuff, and I came back I guess close to 1980. And then I started, I got some calls to tour Europe and I was free to do it, I was on my own again so that’s about where we are.
